scene: Two hundred guests. Seventy-five thousand dollars in flowers, champagne, and crystal chandeliers. And one bride who had spent the last nineteen days planning the destruction of her own wedding.
Another surprise? Baby, you're making me look bad!
Oh, don't worry. You'll have everyone's attention in a minute.
That's fake! Claire, somebody is messing with you!
Young lady, I strongly suggest you turn that projector off.
Mr. Whitmore. I recommend you release my client. Immediately.
Listen carefully. Do not confront him. Do not sign anything.
You're not under arrest at this moment, sir. But we have a court order for your records and your devices.
You wanted a rich wife. Congratulations. You married one. For a few hours.
